run_multinode_training: run multinode training with submitit by executing the script with --ngpus and --nodes arguments
submit_job_with_trainer: submit a LeViT training job to the SLURM scheduler using the Trainer class and AutoExecutor
parse_submitit_args: parse command line arguments for submitit multinode training including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup a Trainer checkpoint that requeues the job with a DelayedSubmission and resumes from checkpoint.pth
get_init_file_uri: get a unique initialization file URI for distributed training using uuid and the shared folder path
